# Test fixtures
Raw provider output captured once from Yahoo (yfinance 1.5.1) on 2026-09-28 by `scripts/capture_fixtures.py`; tests read them through `FakeProvider` in `tests/conftest.py` and never touch the network.
Tickers: **AAPL** (the full case), **SPY** (benchmark history), **HCMC** (sparse case: sub-penny OTC Pink name with ~18 missing info fields, empty news/targets, and `trailingPE` returned as the string `"Infinity"`), **RIVN** (negative-EPS case: pre-profit, negative trailing/forward EPS and forward P/E, debtToEquity > 100), **ZZZZZZ** (unknown symbol: info only, Yahoo returns `{"trailingPegRatio": null}`).
Refresh: `.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/capture_fixtures.py AAPL SPY HCMC RIVN ZZZZZZ`, then re-run pytest; tests read expected values from the fixtures, so only hand-written values need checking.
`agent_outputs/`: the `valuation` and `technicals` agent files from the first live `/research AAPL` (2026-09-28), used by `tests/test_citations.py`. Numbers that differed from the AAPL fixture by more than 1% were set to the fixture's values (technicals: price_vs_sma200/50, pct_from_52w_high/low, rsi_14, return_1y, spy_return_1y, rel_1y, rel_3y; valuation: fair_value.upside, analyst.upside_to_target_mean), in the JSON block and the prose.
Under agent contract v1.1 (every decimal or unit-bearing number cited in its own sentence), uncited sentences were given their citations: technicals' assessment (rel_1y/rel_3y, pct_from_52w_high, price_vs_sma200, max_drawdown_1y, rsi_14, sma_50/sma_200), its reason (rel_1y) and its flag (now `extended`); valuation's `30.8x median` (fair_value.fair_pe) and mean rating 2.2 (analyst.recommendation_mean).
